content:
Ellen: Ugh, luggage delayed on return from Berlin. Had to buy toiletries and a change of clothes for the day. Company card is on the trip but bag was tagged and airline delivered it late. Can we get reimbursed for essentials and taxi due to delay? What receipts do you need?

Sam: Sorry about that. Yes, reimbursable as ‘delayed baggage essentials’. We need receipts for purchases and the airline property irregularity report (PIR). If PIR isn’t immediate, the airline email confirming delay is fine. Keep receipts for clothes/toiletries and taxi. Small items <$50 can be grouped but still need merchant evidence.

Tariq: Quick note 1: company card should be used where possible, but exceptions allowed. If you used personal card, include last4 and a brief attestation. If the airline offers interim reimbursement, include that paperwork and we'll offset.

Ellen: I bought a toothbrush, socks, and a shirt at a convenience store (single receipt $38) and a taxi to the office ($22, cash). I took a photo of the handwritten taxi receipt but lost it later.

Sam: For the cash taxi, if receipt is lost but under $25 we accept the card statement line or a photo of the taxi meter plus a short attestation. Upload the store receipt and taxi attestation.

Lena: Logistics: convert EUR to USD in Expensify on transaction date. Attach boarding pass and the bag tag image showing delay if you have it. Manager approval required for clothing items over $75.

Ellen: Manager approved in DM (screenshot attached). Airline sent PIR confirmation email and a delivery confirmation showing they returned the bag next day. Uploading now.

expensify-bot: Draft created: 2076543210-ELLEN-BERLIN-BAG-DELAY. Missing docs: store receipt, taxi attestation, PIR email. Auto-hold after 48h if missing.

Ellen: Uploaded store receipt, PIR email, DM screenshot from manager. For taxi attestation: I'll upload a 1-line note and the taxi app screenshot (meter photo).

travel-team-bot: Reminder: do not upload passport images. For delayed baggage claims, if airline pays part of essentials, finance will deduct airline reimbursement from total expense.

Sam: Once submitted, tag me and I'll put it on expedited review. Reimbursement policy: toiletries and one-day clothing essentials covered; full wardrobe replacement not covered. If you bought >$75 clothing, we will review and may require justification.

Ellen: Thanks all. Submitted and tagged.
